_readme: Golden battery for `embed-pipeline verify`. Every row is graded: intent rows through /api/sil/probe (the engine's own embedderRouting), names/locations/education rows by embedding the text and querying the env's index directly. Rows must pass on the CURRENTLY SHIPPED system — this file is a regression gate, not a wishlist. Known misses we have decided to live with belong in known_gaps (reported, never graded); promote a row out of known_gaps in the same PR that fixes it.
